items.stem: An AI assistant highlights several sales figures as outliers and offers to delete them. What is the sound analytical response?

options.text: Investigate each flagged value to see whether it is an error or a genuine extreme
options.rationale: Correct: outliers may be real and meaningful; they should be understood before removal.

options.text: Delete them all immediately to clean the data
options.rationale: Blind deletion can discard legitimate, important records.
Flags are worth reviewing even if not acted on automatically.

options.text: Replace them with the average without checking
options.rationale: That fabricates data without understanding the cause.

items.explanation: Correct: outliers may be real and meaningful; they should be understood before removal.

items.stem: Which TWO practices keep AI-assisted conclusions honest? (Select TWO.)

options.text: State the limitations and uncertainty behind a finding
options.rationale: Correct: honest analysis communicates caveats, not just headline numbers.

options.text: Distinguish correlation from causation before claiming a cause
options.rationale: Correct: a relationship in the data does not prove one thing caused another.

options.text: Present the most dramatic interpretation to get attention
Omit the sample size so results look stronger
options.rationale: Hiding sample size conceals real uncertainty.

items.explanation: Correct: honest analysis communicates caveats, not just headline numbers.

items.stem: You asked AI to compare this quarter with last quarter and it returns a confident percentage. Before reporting it, what is the best check?

options.text: Recompute the key figure independently from the source rows
options.rationale: Correct: an independent recomputation confirms the AI used the right data and periods.

options.text: Round it to look cleaner and send it
Ask the AI if it is sure
options.rationale: Self-confirmation by the same tool is not independent.

options.text: Assume quarter boundaries were handled correctly
options.rationale: Period boundaries are a common source of error worth checking.

items.explanation: Correct: an independent recomputation confirms the AI used the right data and periods.
